feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is a single-field change from iteration 6, the best raced design (score 64.74): controller.line_loss goes from last_direction to search_right. Every other field (kp 7.0, kd 0.2, ki 0.0, base_speed 1.4, the weights, and all geometry, including the outer sensors at x = ±0.06 and sensor_size 0.016) is unchanged. All values are inside the contract ranges. The evidence supports the test. Slalom has lost the line exactly once per run in every race (iterations 0 to 7), with progress stuck near 0.10 (iteration 6: 0.1025). Oval and s-bend showed 0 line-loss events in iteration 6, so this field is only expected to act on slalom. Interpret the next race as follows. (a) If slalom line_loss_events fall toward 0 and slalom progress rises above about 0.10, while oval and s-bend hold near iteration 6 (oval about 0.22, s-bend about 0.14), keep search_right. (b) If slalom progress falls or any other track worsens, revert to last_direction; the search direction is then the wrong sign for this course, and slalom should be addressed through geometry (outer sensors at x = ±0.08) instead. (c) If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.6 in a later single-group revision. Approve: the change is low risk and isolates one field, and two more iterations remain, so race telemetry is worth more than another paper revision.
requested_changes: If slalom line_loss_events fall and slalom progress rises above about 0.10 with oval and s-bend held near iteration 6 (oval about 0.22, s-bend about 0.14), keep line_loss = search_right and test outer sensors at x = ±0.08 as the next single-group change for slalom.
If slalom progress falls or oval or s-bend worsen, set line_loss = last_direction again (iteration 6 value), since the search direction would then be the wrong way for the course.
If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, set base_speed = 1.6 in a single-group revision, because the 3.0 s limit needs an average speed of about 1.5 m/s.
